label: BTS 25
title: Great Inventions

3ff908538e49.text: The vacuum cleaner makes cleaning floors much easier.

e60248f31b09.text: Hey, look! I have a new smartphone!

d244685ebcdd.text: Can you call people with that phone?

examples: I can communicate with my friends through online chatting.
Hey, look! I have a new smartphone!
That's nice! What features does it have?
It has tons of features!
Can you call people with that phone?
Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone.
Air conditioning is especially important in hot climates.
I think the stapler is a very useful invention.
People liked zippers because they were faster and easier to use than buttons.
I use my smartphone to do homework and play games.
I can use it to access the internet.
I don't know what I would do without my smartphone.
The dishwasher saves time and water compared to washing by hand.
Do you have a washing machine at home?
Now almost every home has electric lights.
Modern vacuums are more efficient than older models.
What do you usually cook with the microwave?
Before refrigerators, people had to cook fresh food every day.
The microwave heats food very quickly.
The zipper was invented in the late eighteen hundreds.
Scissors are also very helpful. Students use them to cut things.
Modern kitchens have many helpful electrical inventions.
The microscope helps us see very tiny things.
All inventions are useful; people just need to use them properly.
What do you think is the greatest invention ever?
The internet has changed how we communicate.
Email allows us to send messages instantly around the world.
Video calls let us see and talk to people far away.
Social media helps us stay connected with friends and family.
Fans use much less electricity than air conditioners.
Without batteries, flashlights and portable electronics would not work.
Thomas Edison improved the electric light bulb.
The light bulb was invented to replace candles and oil lamps.
The television was invented in the early twentieth century.
Television brings news and entertainment into our homes.
Do you watch television every day?
What is your favorite television program?
The car was invented to replace horse-drawn carriages.
Cars have made transportation faster and more convenient.
Have you ever taken a long car trip?
Flying is faster than driving for long distances.
The airplane allows us to travel long distances quickly.
Modern airplanes can fly all around the world.
The refrigerator keeps food fresh for longer periods.
Many people use microwaves to reheat leftovers.
Before printing presses, books were copied by hand.
The printing press helped spread knowledge.
The printing press was invented in the fifteen hundreds.
The printing press made books cheaper and more available to everyone.
The camera allows us to capture and save memories.
Photography has become an important form of art.
Digital cameras are now more popular than film cameras.
Many people use their smartphone as an alarm clock.
The clock helps us keep track of time.
Without clocks, it would be hard to organize our day.
Watches are portable clocks that we can wear.
The battery provides portable power for many devices.
Many people wear headphones while exercising or commuting.
The compass helped explorers navigate the world.
Ships used compasses to find their direction at sea.
Galileo used the telescope to study the planets.
The telescope allows us to see distant objects in space.
Scientists use microscopes to study bacteria and cells.
The thermometer measures temperature accurately.
Doctors use thermometers to check if patients have a fever.
The elevator makes it easy to go up and down tall buildings.
Skyscrapers would be impractical without elevators.
The escalator is like a moving staircase in shopping malls.
Escalators are helpful in busy places with lots of people.
The air conditioner keeps buildings cool and comfortable.
The vacuum cleaner makes cleaning floors much easier.
The alarm clock helps us wake up on time.
The toaster toasts bread quickly and evenly.
Toasters are a common kitchen appliance.
The fan helps circulate air and cool down a room.
The headphones allow us to listen to music privately.
The speaker amplifies sound so more people can hear it.
Speakers are used in theaters, concerts, and auditoriums.
Solar panels are becoming more popular as a renewable energy source.
The solar panel converts sunlight into electrical energy.
The wind turbine generates electricity from wind power.
Wind turbines are found in many countries around the world.
Inventions continue to improve our quality of life.
New inventions are created every year by engineers and scientists.
The future will likely bring even more amazing inventions.
Technology keeps evolving and changing our world.
Many inventions we use today were created less than fifty years ago.
Can you imagine life without any modern inventions?
Inventions have helped people live longer and healthier lives.
Medical inventions like X-rays and vaccines save lives.
Inventions also create new jobs and opportunities.
The economy benefits from new inventions and technology.
The computer changed the way people work.
Air conditioning keeps buildings cool in summer.
Batteries store energy for later use.
GPS helps us find our way anywhere.
